title: Frank & Atticus – Berry Jam Danish 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Berry Jam Danish 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ Berry Jam Danish is a light and airy pastry filled with sweet blueberry and raspberry jam, almond slices, and a dollop of cream cheese.
As soon as the vapour slides over your tongue, the sweet yet tangy blueberry jam smothers your taste buds, making your mouth swim as the fresh raspberry flavour comes through. Then, as you savour bakery pastry topped with freshly roasted almonds, thick creamy butter offers a contrast to the flavour.
Berry Jam Danish e-liquid is a flavour explosion, ideal for breakfast or as your next all-day dessert vape.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
